body:
> Research · Pipeliners · 2026-09-19

# Summary
Research for one blog post that sends visitors and links to the Wave 1 and 2 city pages (Glendale, Avondale, Goodyear, Paradise Valley, San Tan Valley, Coolidge, Laveen, Casa Grande) without targeting the city searches themselves. Sources: Search Atlas and a Sep 19 crawl of every sitemap page.

# Options
| Topic | Volume / KD | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| clay sewer pipe | 1,223 / 21 | Write first (no page has it in a heading) |
| orangeburg pipe | 8,550 / 33 | Second post, later |
| orangeburg sewer pipe | 525 / 36 | Fold into the Orangeburg post |
| sewer scope inspection | 3,600 / 29 | The Mesa camera post owns it; improve that instead |
| sewer lateral | 2,241 / 40 | Skip for now (hard; ownership answers need verified city rules) |

# Recommended post
"Clay Sewer Pipe: Common Problems and How to Fix It Without Digging": what clay pipe is, problems (roots at joints, cracks, offsets, bellies), repair options, when lining won't work, FAQ. Links out to 2-4 Wave 1/2 city pages where natural, plus the no-dig and tree roots posts; links in from /phoenix-sewer-line-problems/ and /signs-of-outdated-sewer-drain-pipes/. No lifespan, price or build-year claims unless verified.
